value.name: Residential Solar and Storage Equity — paired solar component (waitlisted)
value.description: This entry is scoped to eligible SCE-served homes in Cathedral City. SCE is the program administrator; no unverified default generation supplier is asserted. The program includes solar paired with eligible storage for qualifying low-income residential customers. The administrator tracker, retrieved on 2026-10-01 and displaying 2026-09-30 data, lists SCE AB 209 Non-POU as Waitlist. This is the solar component of the same paired program referenced under battery_programs, not a separate or standalone award.
value.eligibility: Income-qualified residential customers; solar and storage must meet program rules. Eligibility, any waitlist place and a funding reservation must be confirmed with the administrator. No available reservation is asserted.

rebates.notes: Paired solar component, not an additional award beyond the storage program. Verified tracker data date: 2026-09-30.
